raw_response: The invention is a computer‑implemented method for semi‑supervised contrastive learning of visual representations. It begins by selecting an unlabeled training image and applying two distinct sets of augmentation operations to produce a first and a second augmented view of the same image. Each augmented view is independently fed through a shared base encoder network to generate intermediate feature representations, which are then passed through a multi‑layer projection head to produce projected representations. A loss function measures the discrepancy between the two projected representations, and the resulting gradient is used to update the parameters of the base encoder and/or the projection head, thereby refining the visual representation model in a semi‑supervised setting.
